records.name: Progress in Energy
records.scope_notes: Research and synthesis across the global energy transition; computational or existing-data studies must meet its significance requirements.

route.conditions: Subscription publication is free; gold open access is optional and paid. Authors must first submit an outline for all reviews and perspectives; research papers need a justification statement.

fee_evidence.note: Official journal charges section states subscription publication is free, no submission charges and no other publishing charges.

notes: Eight candidate journals; fee and AI policy require independent role audits. Indexed Royal Society of Chemistry policy permits disclosed GenAI drafting, code refinement and visualization but does not by itself resolve every substantive research and analysis use; AI compatibility must not be assumed. https://www.rsc.org/publishing/journals/processes-and-policies/author-responsibilities

RSC direct pages returned HTTP 403; indexed official text explicitly states no submission or publication fee for five titles. Ancillary fees and direct current page verification remain outstanding. Environmental Science: Processes & Impacts and Environmental Modelling & Software are provisional leads with fee evidence unresolved.
